svg.title: Land-cover segmentation
svg.desc: Research · Published In Joeis. A U-Net designed from scratch with a custom focal-Tversky + weighted cross-entropy loss for 7-class land-cover maps of DeepGlobe satellite imagery, plus a Streamlit app for inference.
svg.text: A U-Net designed from scratch with a custom focal-Tversky +
weighted cross-entropy loss for 7-class land-cover maps of
DeepGlobe satellite imagery, plus a Streamlit app for inference.
